videos.title: 就业意外转负：市场为何不慌？，生产率回升或是关键
videos.source_title: Why This "Scary" Jobs Report Might Be Good News | ITK With Cathie Wood
videos.description: In this month's "In The Know," Cathie explains why inference costs collapsing 99.99% per year set the stage for an entrepreneurial explosion, why the United Arab Emirates (UAE) pumping a record 4.1 million barrels per day suggests oil prices have peaked, and why Truflation's 1.5% core inflation reading, far below the official numbers, means the Federal Reserve (Fed) will not tighten. Plus: the yield curve is behaving the way it did during the Industrial Revolution, and Bitcoin is finding its legs against gold.
videos.speaker: Cathie Wood
